return $('Config').all().map(it => ({ json: { body: {
  filterGroups: [{ filters: [
    { propertyName: 'hs_lastmodifieddate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(it.json.fromMs) },
    { propertyName: 'hs_lastmodifieddate', operator: 'LT', value: String(it.json.toMs) }]}],
  properties: ['dealname','amount','dealstage','pipeline','dealtype','createdate','closedate',
    'hs_is_closed_won','hs_is_closed','hubspot_owner_id','hs_next_step','notes_last_updated','hs_mrr','license_start_date__c','contract_signed_on__c'],
  sorts: [{ propertyName: 'hs_object_id', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 200 } } }));
